6. How the numbers are calculated

  • Test BR: a business rule of the AI team's knowledge base routed to the BR. Network BR: ledger states tested_host, tested_device, composition_gap, claimed_no_template, cited_only, sme. Not counted: not_applicable and informational rules, and the rules routed to the shared BRs (data_element, operations), which are counted under their own BR in section 2.
  • Traced to a scenario: the BR's test design (a technique of its scenarios) claims the rule, or a test case cites it: every state except sme.
  • Covered by a test case: a test case sets, breaks or asserts the rule's own item (tested_host, tested_device). A test case that only quotes the rule leaves it cited_only.
  • Covered by test data: covered by a test case that sends a message to BUYPASS, i.e. has a test data file (tested_host). Device-only test cases have no test data.
  • Rule ledger: mastercard_credit_new_16_11\coverage\rule_ledger.csv (run). Test cases: test_cases/test_cases.jsonl. Test data files listed: 2,422, found in test_data/: 2,422.
  • The ATL105 content of the test data (field formats, segment lengths, flows) is not part of this report; see the ATL105 validation reports.
